setup.benchmark_methodology: Expert-authored task-specific rubrics across eight software-engineering dimensions; grader models use unit tests, static analysis, and other executable evidence where appropriate.
setup.notes: The live leaderboard gives the exact 28.9% value. The linked Oct. 13 explainer rounds GPT-6.1 Sol to roughly 30%; the current leaderboard snapshot is retained as the exact value. The leaderboard does not expose aggregation details.

coverage_gaps.reason: OpenAI’s launch page gives only relative claims for DeepSWE v1.1 (+6.4 percentage points over GPT-6 Sol at a lower effort/cost), OSWorld 2.0 (+7 points over GPT-6 Sol at max), Terminal-Bench Science 0.1 (more than doubles GPT-6 Sol at max), and AutomationBench (+4.8 points over GPT-6 Sol at medium). No absolute GPT-6.1 score appears in that page. Current evaluator leaderboards checked on 2026-10-17 did not expose a GPT-6.1 result on DeepSWE or OSWorld; the current AutomationBench list also has no GPT-6.1 row. Do not assign GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6 Sol, or relative deltas as GPT-6.1 scores.

coverage_gaps.scope: GPT-6.1 Sol scores shown only in report figures
coverage_gaps.reason: The OpenAI launch page includes comparative visual material, but no exact, unambiguous numeric GPT-6.1 value was recoverable from the accessible figure text. No values were estimated from bar heights or attributed from GPT-6 Astra. The system-card KernelGen 1P results are likewise discussed but do not provide a score in accessible text; excluded.

coverage_gaps.scope: GPT-6.1 Sol third-party aggregated score lists
coverage_gaps.reason: Several model-score aggregator pages were found, but they mix estimates with measurements or lack sufficient public protocol/source locators for this fragment. They are excluded in favor of evaluator-hosted Parallel and Surge leaderboards and OpenAI’s primary system-card tables.
